memory_candidates.content: In this codebase, generate-context-line-counts.sh refuses to run from the agent-system/extensions/<ext>/scripts/ source-store copy (repo-root guard error naming the deployed path), and must be invoked via the deployed .claude/scripts/ path instead -- but it still writes line_count regenerations into the SOURCE STORE's index-entries.json (confirmed via git status/git diff), so running the deployed binary is still the correct edit-target-preserving invocation, not a detour around source-store-deploy-boundary.md.

verify-touched.sh's OWED fallback triggers whenever index-entries.json (or any other unmapped manifest/index file) is among the touched paths passed to it, expanding what looks like a small named-suite check into a ~98-suite, multi-minute cost-class-free sweep. Budget for this by using the bounded-build-waiter detached pattern (nohup + captured PID + kill -0 poll loop across tool calls) rather than a single foreground call with a short timeout, since the OWED sweep alone can exceed 10 minutes under load.

sapience_notes.subject: generate-context-line-counts.sh invocation
sapience_notes.value: The script refuses to run from the agent-system source-store scripts/ copy (repo-root guard), but must be run via the deployed .claude/scripts/ path; it still writes line_count regenerations into the SOURCE STORE's index-entries.json, confirmed via git diff.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh OWED fallback cost
sapience_notes.value: Passing an unmapped index/manifest file (e.g. index-entries.json) as a touched path triggers a cost-class-free OWED fallback sweep of ~98 suites, which can take 5+ minutes even though the named Tier Justification suites are few -- this is a real, repeatable cost, not a one-off.

sapience_notes.subject: test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh and test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh
sapience_notes.value: Both are documented known-failures.txt entries (load-sensitive/real-defect classes respectively) that can surface as failures in an unrelated dispatch's verify-touched.sh run without indicating any regression from that dispatch's own edits -- confirmed by zero git diff overlap and run-all.sh's own '0 NEW' failure accounting.

sapience_notes.subject: Sweep-authoritative phase pattern
sapience_notes.value: When a plan phase instructs 're-run the sweep grep and treat its output as the authoritative work list,' the live grep can legitimately find more surfaces than the plan's own pre-computed Scope Hypothesis named -- in task 662's Phase 5, 2 extra surfaces (preflight-postflight.md, git-integration.md) were found and reframed beyond the plan's declared 6-file list, following the phase's own explicit instruction rather than treating the plan's list as a ceiling.

sapience_notes.subject: lint-subject-resolution-declaration.sh cascading failure
sapience_notes.value: A pre-existing violation in agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh (unrelated to any specific task's edits, confirmed via empty git diff over the task's full commit range) was observed to cascade into a second, independently-documented test's fixture-setup failure (test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh), because that test's own fixture requires a full verify-deploy run to report zero findings.

sapience_notes.subject: Posture-skip documentation reframe pattern
sapience_notes.value: When softening a documentation surface's unqualified 'git commit created' assertion to cover a V13 posture-skip outcome, leave success-path-only log lines unchanged (e.g. 'Log: Git commit created: {hash}') and only soften the outcome-summarizing checkpoint/criterion lines that frame commit creation as the sole possible result -- applied consistently across 9+ surfaces in task 662.
